scope: Ticket 01 seed cases and ticket 02 Windows automation baseline. Other tickets must extend this index; this is not the complete 105+45 or E1-E7/R1-R7 acceptance matrix.

requirements.title: Independent Common Event saved-state roundtrip through actual Workspace source evaluation

sources.section: ### T1 — 已确认的测试边界与现有基础

requirements.input: One self-authored Common Event, inactive default switchId, Show Text with literal CR and trailing empty continuation, Comment with trailing empty continuation, final code 0; minimal independent standard project data.
requirements.expected: Complete parsed CommonEvents.json and System.json equal the independent fixture. All generated definition files appear in compile manifest Discovery; changing generated source changes compiled event name, then restoration restores exact data. Project Root and complete Snapshot remain unchanged.

test.name: MV-S0-CE-001: discovers and evaluates Decompiled Source against independent saved data

execution.environment: Windows / Node 22; no editor, game runtime, assets, or local references required
execution.owner: Automated test runner; agent records reviewed run
execution.layer: Actual temporary filesystem and public Workspace API

requirements.title: Strict complete saved-state comparison detects structural and value losses
requirements.input: Independent copies with one mutation each: final 0 removed, indent key removed, CR removed, trailing empty text record removed, inactive switchId changed, leading null removed, empty array changed to null, external unknown field removed.
requirements.expected: The identical deepStrictEqual comparator used in the Workspace roundtrip rejects every mutation. Neither operand is filtered or normalized.

test.name: MV-S0-COMPARE-001: rejects every saved-state loss without normalizing either side

execution.environment: Windows / Node 22; independent synthetic JSON only
execution.owner: Automated test runner; agent records reviewed run

requirements.title: Independent minimal Workspace through source and built Windows CLI subprocesses

sources.section: ### T1 — 已确认的测试边界与现有基础

requirements.input: The independent Common Event fixture reconstructed in a unique Windows directory containing Chinese characters and spaces. Real Node CLI processes perform init, clone, decompile, check, compile, diff and push, then edit source and push a replacement. Built verification resolves actual emitted package declarations.
requirements.expected: Check publishes neither output nor manifest. Actual discovered source reconstructs full independent saved data. No-op Push succeeds, edited source replaces only expected data and refreshes Snapshot. Invalid option exits 1 with stderr while source, project, generated data, Snapshot and manifest remain unchanged. Source and built CLI runs must both pass.

test.name: MV-S0-WIN-CLI-001: runs the minimal Workspace through actual Windows CLI processes

execution.environment: Windows / Node 22; source CLI during pnpm check, built CLI after pnpm build
execution.owner: Automated test runner; CI retains evidence and failing sandboxes
execution.layer: Actual Windows filesystem, public CLI subprocesses, independent fixture equality

requirements.title: Windows junction CLI entry executes without permission-based skipping
requirements.input: A real Windows directory junction aliases the source or built CLI directory. The aliased entry is executed by a separate Node process from a unique Unicode and space-containing Workspace directory.
requirements.expected: Both source and built aliased CLI print usage and exit 0. Junction creation failure, timeout, wrong runtime, missing entry and subprocess failure are visible failures, never silent skips.

test.name: MV-S0-WIN-JUNCTION-001: executes CLI through a mandatory Windows directory junction

execution.environment: Windows / Node 22 with real NTFS junction support; no administrator-only file symlink prerequisite
execution.owner: Automated test runner; CI retains failure diagnostics
execution.layer: Actual Windows directory junction and CLI subprocess
